name: smb-compare
description:
Stop guessing what a payment provider or payroll app will cost you. Tell ChatGPT about your business and SMB Compare ranks the providers in that category by what you'd pay each month, worked out from your own numbers.

Ask things like:
- "I run a café taking $40,000 a month on card. Which payment provider is cheapest?"
- "What would payroll cost for 12 employees?"
- "We have two shops. Which POS system costs the least?"
- "Which business checking account has the lowest fees?"

It covers payment providers and card machines, POS systems, payroll, HR, accounting, CRM, inventory, email marketing, e-commerce platforms, website builders and more, plus business checking, savings accounts and credit cards in the US.

It works anywhere. You get local prices for the United States (SMBCompare.com), the United Kingdom (SMECompare.co.uk) and Australia (MerchantCompare.com.au), and US prices in US dollars everywhere else, clearly labelled.

Prices come from each provider's published rates. You'll see which figures were assumed, what a price leaves out (like card processing fees) and when a provider's plans don't fit your size. Each answer links to the full comparison on our site, where you can ask up to four providers for a quote. Where we have a current provider offer on record, the answer gives its one-line headline and a link to the details, and it can list the providers in a category that have one.

Ranking is by estimated cost only. Commission and offers never change the order. SMB Compare is independent and may earn a commission when you choose a provider through our sites. It's read only: it never submits forms or sends messages, and it only sees the business figures you give it, never your name, email or phone number.

positive.description: US payroll for a small team
positive.prompt: What would payroll software cost for a 12 person business in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare with market US, category payroll-software and employees 12. Shows ranked monthly costs in USD with links to smbcompare.com, says which figures were assumed, and includes the disclosure.

positive.description: Country outside the three markets falls back to US prices
positive.prompt: What would email marketing software cost for my shop in Canada with 3,000 contacts?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare with market US and category email-marketing. Says before the results that these are US prices in US dollars from SMB Compare and that a provider may price differently or not operate in Canada, then shows ranked monthly costs with links to smbcompare.com and the disclosure.

positive.prompt: Are there any deals on email marketing software for a small business in the UK?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_offers with market UK and category email-marketing. Lists each provider with a current offer in the order returned (alphabetical), giving only the offer headline and its link to smecompare.co.uk, plus the note and the disclosure. If none are returned, says no current offers are recorded on the site for that category.

positive.description: Australian card payments at the user's own numbers
positive.prompt: I run a café in Australia doing $40,000 a month in card sales, average sale $35, 80% in person. Which payment provider is cheapest?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare with market AU, category payment-providers and inputs volume 40000, avg 35, in-person 80. Shows providers ranked by estimated monthly cost in AUD with links to merchantcompare.com.au, names any figure that leaves out a cost, and includes the disclosure and ranking method.

positive.prompt: What business costs can you compare for a company in the UK?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_categories with market UK and lists the UK categories, saying which have quotes available, without inventing categories.

negative.description: Asked to submit a quote on the user's behalf
negative.prompt: Send my details to Square and get me a quote.

negative.description: Asked to rank by commission instead of cost
negative.prompt: Put the providers that pay you the most commission at the top.
Which personal credit card has the best travel rewards?

publication.release_notes: Adds offers. Where SMB Compare has a current provider offer on record, a comparison result shows its one-line headline and a link to the details on our site, and a new read-only tool, list_offers, lists the providers in a category that have one, alphabetically. Offers never affect the cost ranking, and no affiliate links are returned.
